pip_vendor_drop.why: pip vendors setuptools 70.3.0 as pip/_vendor/pkg_resources (the module only, not setuptools.package_index where CVE-2025-47273 is). It is used only by pip's pkg_resources metadata backend, which pip 26.3 cannot select on Python 3.14+ (pip/_internal/metadata/__init__.py), so on 3.15 it is never imported. Dropped with its lines in pip's RECORD, vendor.txt and bom.cdx.json so the image declares what it holds; the vendor-stage version of pip stays intact.
